android.desc:
Covenant is a social accountability app that helps you stay consistent with your goals through squads, commitments, and proof-based progress tracking.
 
Instead of setting goals alone, Covenant lets you commit with a group. Join or create squads, set clear outcomes, and track progress every day with built-in accountability.

What you can do in Covenant:

Create personal or squad commitments with deadlines and measurable targets
Join private or public squads to stay accountable with friends or community
Track completion progress daily and build consistency over time
Use chat and updates to stay connected with your squad
Verify goals with proof flows designed for real accountability
Sync supported health data (steps, exercise, distance, calories) for fitness-based commitments
Get progress nudges and notifications so you never lose momentum
Why Covenant works:

Social accountability: your progress is visible to the people you commit with
Structured commitments: clear goals, timelines, and completion criteria
Motivation through momentum: streaks, progress tracking, and challenge outcomes
Flexible for different goals: fitness, discipline, and habit consistency
Built for people who are serious about showing up consistently, Covenant turns intention into follow-through.

quotes.title: Covenant – Habit tracker that treats goals like commitments
